name: hacker-news-top-stories
title: Hacker News Top Stories
description: A menubar extension to view top stories on Hacker News based on a configurable points threshold.
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: view-top-stories
commands.title: Hacker News Top Stories Menu Bar
commands.description: View recent Hacker News stories based on a configurable points threshold.

tools.name: get-stories
tools.title: Get Stories
tools.description: Get the current top Hacker News stories, newest first, with links, points, comments and read state.

tools.name: mark-stories-as-read
tools.title: Mark Stories as Read
tools.description: Mark Hacker News stories as read when the user asks to.

tools.name: get-comments
tools.title: Get Comments
tools.description: Get what people are saying about a Hacker News story, top comment threads first.

tools.name: search-comments
tools.title: Search Comments
tools.description: Search Hacker News comments by keyword, in one story or across all of Hacker News.

tools.name: read-article
tools.title: Read Article
tools.description: Read what a Hacker News story is about: the article it links to, or the text of an Ask HN post.

preferences.name: points
preferences.title: Minimum Points
preferences.description: Minimum points to show stories. Updating this will reset your activity.

preferences.name: useStoryIcon
preferences.title: Notification Icon
preferences.description: Use the story icon instead of the default Hacker News icon.
preferences.label: Use Story Icons

preferences.name: syncWithICloud
preferences.title: iCloud Sync
preferences.description: Sync read stories between your Macs through the "Raycast Hacker News" folder in iCloud Drive.
preferences.label: Sync Read Stories with iCloud Drive

preferences.name: markReadByAi
preferences.title: Raycast AI
preferences.description: Mark a story as read when Raycast AI reads its article or comments.
preferences.label: Mark Stories Raycast AI Reads as Read

ai.instructions: Always call get-stories before answering anything about Hacker News. Never answer from memory, and never describe what you are about to do instead of calling the tools. When the user asks about particular stories (the latest one or few, the first unread, or one by name), call read-article for each of them and summarize what each says, with its points and discussion link. Reply with only a list of titles when the user asks for the list itself. Use get-comments for what people are saying about a story, search-comments to find something in a discussion, and mark-stories-as-read only when the user asks to mark stories read.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
